title: Avocado Oil vs Avocado Cream for Face: Which Is Better?
ex: Pure avocado oil or a cream? How they differ, which skin types suit each, and how to mix a drop of oil into your cream on dry nights.
rt: Avocado Oil vs Avocado Cream for Face | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado oil vs avocado cream for face: how pure oil and cream differ, which suits oily, dry or combination skin, and how to use both safely in Indian weather.
keyword: avocado oil vs avocado cream for face
quick: For most faces, avocado cream is easier to use. Oil adds only oil and can feel heavy in heat and humidity, while a cream gives water and oil together and can carry ingredients like niacinamide. Oil suits very dry skin in small amounts.
facts: Avocado oil is rich in oleic acid
Oil adds oil only; cream adds water and oil
Two or three drops of oil is enough for a face
One drop of oil can be mixed into cream on dry nights
